dct_description_sm: Mesozooplankton data were used to document the prey selectivity of 4 age-0 fish, and the distribution of these prey, in the Greenland Sea in 2017, for inclusion in the following scientific article: Caroline Bouchard, Julek Chawarski, Maxime Geoffroy, Apasiri Klasmeier, Eva Friis Mller, Christian Mohn, Mette Dalgaard Agersted (accepted for publication) Interspecific competition and recruitment of age-0 fish in the Greenland Sea: the role of transport and preferred prey availability. Elementa: Science of the Anthropocene.
dct_title_s: Mesozooplankton abundance (0-100 m) of selected taxa in the Greenland Sea in August-September 2017
